reading.summary: A Calvinistic Baptist account of inward, public and private worship.
reading.startingPoint: Begin with the nature of worship; compare the sacramental sections with the historic confessions.
cautions: Its Baptist account of baptism differs from Westminster’s infant-baptism teaching.
